title: Looking for an old RPG Maker game with monster arena mode

posts.author: Giancarlo_Ferraro
posts.body:
Hi everyone!
I’m trying to identify an old RPG Maker game I played between
2001–2005
, likely created in
RPG Maker 2000 or 2003
, and possibly included in
CD-ROM collections
(such as Brazilian "1000 games" discs).
What I remember:​
The game starts with a
"New Game" screen that offers two modes
.
One was the
main story mode
, possibly a traditional JRPG-style quest.
The
second mode
(optional or extra) was a
monster battle arena
with completely different gameplay.
About the arena mode:​
You could
build a team of monsters
(e.g., slimes, demons, etc.).
Each monster had its own
role/build
(like
healer
,
tank
,
DPS
).
Battles didn’t happen in the typical RPG Maker combat screen
, but instead used
sprites on the map
, kind of like a Pokémon or tactical system.
Monsters
leveled up and evolved
as they fought in the arena.
Additional Clues:​
I
originally thought it was part of Laxius Power 3 or Legion Saga 3
, because the presentation and scale of the game felt similar to those — large world, big cast, polished menus.
Might have been in
English or Portuguese
.
Could’ve come bundled in a
CD-ROM collection
of indie RPGs.
If anyone remembers something like this — maybe a spinoff mode of a major RPG Maker game — I’d love your help! Even a vague memory might lead to the title.
Thanks so much in advance
